q: What goes into a CBAM monitoring methodology document?
title: CBAM monitoring document: what goes in
short: It describes how your figures are made: the installation and its production processes, every source stream and emission source, the method and factors used, where each number comes from, who checks it, and how gaps are filled. A verifier reads it first, then tests your records against it.

ul: Production processes and the goods in each.
Source streams: fuels and materials, with how each is measured.
Data flow from meter or invoice to the final figure.
Control checks and how missing data is handled.

p: Write what you actually do. A document that describes meters you do not have will fail the first site visit.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, power and production records into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions your EU importer asks for.

sources.label: European Commission, CBAM legislation and guidance
